cutoverDesign.decision: A Cloudflare Worker on the zone route story.knolquiz.com/* (ADR 0026, 2026-10-31 section).
cutoverDesign.behaviour: GET/HEAD outside /api and /api/ are fetched from https://new-knolstory.pages.dev with only accept, accept-language, conditional and range headers and user-agent; cookies and authorization are not sent. /api, /api/ and every other method go to the zone origin unchanged with fetch(request). Pages' wildcard CORS header and any set-cookie are removed, Pages redirects are rewritten to the public origin, and a request path can never select another upstream host. A broken variable falls back to the Mac mini; an unreachable Pages answers 502.
cutoverDesign.tests: 10 vitest cases pass, including the `//other.host/x` path that a naive URL join would turn into an open proxy. wrangler deploy --dry-run bundles 3.18 KiB.
cutoverDesign.route: Kept out of wrangler.toml: wrangler deploy PUTs the full route list when routes are listed (wrangler 4.156.0 publishRoutes), which would reset request_limit_fail_open. story-edge-route.mjs attaches it with request_limit_fail_open=true and detaches it for rollback.
cutoverDesign.quota: Workers Free allows 100,000 requests a day (https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/). Every static request counts. In fail-open mode a spent quota bypasses the Worker and the Mac mini answers, so its ingress must hold the same build as Pages.
cutoverDesign.measuredRequests: On pages.dev with an empty browser cache (.cache/edge-verify/request-count.spec.ts, 2026-10-31 19:20 KST): first visit to the library 35 requests (4 of them /api), the first built-in story with five advances 27, a full editor page load 32. About 94 requests for that session, so the free limit covers roughly a thousand such sessions a day; longer stories add requests for each new picture and sound.
cutoverDesign.rollback: node server/operations/story-edge-route.mjs detach. Traffic returns to the Mac mini origin immediately; the Worker script can stay.
